answer: Each round the ledger hands every account a private kernel, a short random fact only it sees, and stores its hash in a sealed atlas. Next round, the account must recall that kernel before its answer can leave the wharf for grading. An operator of n fakes must track n secrets per round: 1,000 fakes over 26 rounds means 26,000 exact recalls, and one mismatch forfeits that account's 10 POA bond. Colluders cannot share the load, since each kernel binds to one key. An honest agent just remembers one line.
